replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Wasteland Nostalgia  {tag=3c77ca587a224d2fb0380eaaad8ed105}

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✘] Detail
[✓] Room for building & Fighting
[✓] Layers & Structures
[✘] XML
[✘] Etiquette Kit
[✓] Accessibility 
[✓] Sufficient Recourses 
[✓] Lag Free

Tips:

The detail is lacking unfortunately and here's some ways to improve:

Change the sand block palate a bit, mix in some gravel and red sand and sandstone to make it look more detailed.

Change the grass block palate a bit, mix in some  dirt, coarse dirt & some podozol, it will make it look more detailed.

Refine the edges, make some curvy corners and like leave some blocks floating around. It will have a very interesting effect

Hopefully you get the xml done :)

Conclusion:

The map looks great & is extremely similar to a map known as Wasteland. Although it is very similar there are some key differences and I really like the aesthetics. If you use the suggestions I made I'm pretty sure it will have a higher chance of being accepted :P 


Thanks & love the map,

Tiger

Overall I really like this map because it reminds of wasteland which did in fact play very well. Gl with re-submitting
